basic_info.description: Tucked away in Bernal Heights, this charming 2BD/1BA + huge bonus room condominium offers a perfect blend of modern updates and timeless character, including a large private, sunny patio. High ceilings, elegant arched entryways, wood floors, and classic period details highlight the home's San Francisco charm. A formal living and dining room flow effortlessly into the stylish, modern eat-in kitchen, featuring a Viking range, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, custom-built Island, and a sunlit greenhouse window. The spacious full bathroom stuns with a striking copper mosaic tile accent wall with shower and tub. Step outside to a generous private deck, bathed in natural light, ideal for relaxing, BBQ's, or entertaining. Head downstairs to an additional large flex room providing space for an office, home gym, media room, storage or more! A private laundry room with side by side washer and dryer, ample storage, and central heat complete this magnificent home. Prime location just three blocks from Cortland Avenue's shops and cafes, with easy access to 280/101 and Transit/Muni. Welcome home to this Bernal beauty!
